facts.text: Deborah visited a place that was described as calming and nostalgic.

evidence.quote: I just visited this place and it was so calming. Nostalgic too.

facts.text: Deborah mentioned that the roses and dahlias in the garden bring her peace.

evidence.quote: The roses and dahlias bring me peace.

facts.text: Deborah lost a friend last week and has been spending time in the garden to find comfort.

evidence.quote: I lost a friend last week, so I've been spending time in the garden to find some comfort.

facts.text: Deborah expressed that remembering time spent with the speaker reminds her of how special life is.

evidence.quote: It reminds me of how special life is.
